meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: Claude 转为编排者角色,自己不直接干活,而是派出子代理逐阶段执行计划:每阶段先派 Implementation 子代理做实现,再派 Verification、Anti-pattern、Code Quality 子代理核查,验证通过才提交,阶段之间同步分支。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或落实一份计划时接管,尤其是 make-plan 生成的计划。

say.note: 会派子代理逐阶段实现并验证

say.text: 把 plans/payment.md 里的计划跑一遍
say.note: 每阶段用新子代理,验证通过才提交

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an orchestrator and does no work itself: it deploys subagents to run a phased plan — an Implementation agent per phase, then Verification, Anti-pattern and Code Quality agents — committing only after verification passes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to execute, run or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.note: Spawns subagents to implement and verify each phase
Fresh subagents per phase; commits only after verification
